Web Content Manager/Editor  (short-term contract)
positions.description: Working on large project to migrate content of Hyatt's global website (nearly 500 hotel sites) from Adobe CQ 6 to Adobe Experience Manager.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Specialist (short-term contract)
positions.description: Digital Media Specialist (contractor) designing marketing collateral and creating digital assets using Adobe Creative Suite applications (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat) and managing web and email content for PanduitOne Partner Program using Relayware.

positions.title: Digital Content Specialist  (short-term contract)
positions.description: Digital Content Coordinator (contractor) working to complete content migration from Drupal 7 to Drupal 8, develop marketing campaign landing pages/ebooks, troubleshoot content management  and manage daily web content. Primary software used included Drupal, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop Dreamweaver, Acrobat), Big Tin Can, Microsoft Office Suite, and programming included HTML, CSS, Jquery and Bootstrap.

positions.title: Digital Media Coordinator
positions.description:
Worked on architecture and front-end design of company website, development of mobile web solutions, implementation and editing of HTML/CSS and javascript/Bootstrap. Content management systems included Medseek, Convert on Demand, and WordPress.

Led development of user experience design improvements and implementation of WCAG-based accessibility standards
Projects included : Physician Directory redesign, Hospital Landing Page redesign, Marketing campaign landing page designs, Mobile Website redesign.

Maintained and developed online reputation management systems and strategies.

Monitored, maintained and developed analytics frameworks and dashboards. Analyze data related to web traffic in order to point out key areas of importance.

Supported search engine marking campaign by performing daily account management and pay per click accounts, recommendation for content and conversion analysis, perform key word research.

Aligned system search engine optimization strategy with search engine marketing activities to optimize results for both organic and paid search.

Managed Google Ads and coordinated with third-party services and vendors on PPC campaigns.

positions.title: ComEd e-Channels Web/Social Media Business Analyst (contractor)
positions.description:
Manage and execute all aspects of Social Media and Website development and maintenance, including:
• Develops and edits content for the social media landscape and provides ongoing guidance to partner organizations on how to use social media in support of daily operations and customer-focused campaigns.
• Create, edit, manage and post online content. Content management systems included Microsoft Sharepoint Service (MOSS) and custom CMS.
• Adhere to the company digital user experience standards and guidelines – including usability, graphic design, branding, information architecture, navigation, content and functionality.
• Apply best practice principles of usability, graphic design, online customer self-service, communications, and marketing.  Creates new site / service development, including assisting with requirements gathering, creating functional site prototypes, and testing.

positions.title: Web Manager (Chicago Office of Tourism and Culture)
positions.description: As a member of the Marketing team, I am responsible for the layout, visual appearance, usability, maintenance and development of City of Chicago, Department of Cultural Affairs and Special Events (DCASE) and Chicago Office of Tourism and Culture (COTC) websites as well as providing support on marketing email campaigns, blogs and print designs. Websites include ExploreChicago.org ( Chicago's official tourism website), Millenniumpark.org, ChicagoCulturalCenter.org, Fashion Focus Chicago, Chicago SummerDance, World Music Festival: Chicago, Maxim's and others. Content management systems used included Adobe CQ, WordPress, Filenet, Broadvision, and Drupal. Software used includes Dreamweaver, GoLive, Homesite, Final Cut, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Microsoft Office.

positions.title: Department Webmaster
positions.description: Responsible for daily/ongoing maintenance and content management of City of Chicago, Department of Cultural Affairs websites and city intranet site. Websites include Cityofchicago.org, ExploreChicago.org, Millenniumpark.org, ChicagoCulturalCenter.org, CItyofchicagostore.com, Shopattheculturalcenter.com, ChicagoSummerDance.org, WorldMusicFestivalChicago.org, Clarkehousemuseum.org, Maximschicago.org and others. As part of the DCA Communications division, I was also involved in various duties involving graphic design and IT services. Content management systems used included Day Communique/Adobe CQ, WordPress, Filenet, Broadvision, and Drupal. Software used includes Pagemaker, QuarkXpress, InDesign, GoLive, Homesite, Final Cut, Photoshop, Illustrator, Freehand, Premiere, Videoshop and Microsoft Office.
